create.name: Keith Parker
create.bio:
Keith Parker is an energy healing teacher and author who set up Field Dynamics with Christabel Armsden in 2018. He came to this work through meditation, which he first used to explore subtle states of mind, and then spent roughly ten years studying movement, breathwork, bodywork and energy work. Along the way he trained in hands-on somatic methods such as craniosacral biodynamics and Zero Balancing. He says that experiences during those years left him able to see the human aura clearly, and that way of perceiving sits at the heart of what he teaches.

In his book Radical Reality he asks what the energy field can show us about consciousness and the link between mind and body. With Christabel he leads EHT-100 and EHT-200, live online trainings in energy healing that run for several months and mix teaching on subtle anatomy with group sessions and practice swaps between students. They also offer short online workshops and a free library of guided practices, and co-host The Future of Wellness podcast. On Insight Timer he shares guided meditations and short talks on grounding, energetic awareness, past lives and psychic perception.

books.title: Radical Reality: How Seeing the Aura Reveals Who & What We Are
books.author: Keith Parker
books.description: Keith's account of how he came to see the aura and what that perception suggests about consciousness, the mind-body link and the nature of reality. It mixes personal story with ideas from science and contemplative traditions, and closes with thoughts on where energy work may be heading.

courses.title: EHT-100: Energy Healing Training, Level 1
courses.description: A four-month live online training with Keith and Christabel covering subtle anatomy, energetic perception and hands-on technique, with group healing sessions, guided exchanges between students and a private session with a facilitator. The next cohort listed runs from February to June 2027.

courses.title: EHT-200: Energy Healing Training, Level 2
courses.description: An eight-module advanced training for EHT-100 graduates that refines technique and practitioner skills through deeper exchanges and supervised practice, with optional Field Dynamics certification. It runs once a year.

free_resources.title: Keith Parker on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations and short talks from Keith on grounding, sensing your own energy, chakras, past lives and psychic perception. Listen in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Field Dynamics Guided Practice Library
free_resources.description: A free collection of audio practices from Field Dynamics, including chakra sensing, vital energy and pranic breathing, body scans, and Samatha and Vipassana meditations.
